title: User Plane Function Services; Stage 3 (UPF SBI)
tagline: UPF — user plane where SMF enforces SmPolicyDecision
summary: TS 29.564 defines SBI services exposed by the UPF, including event exposure and UE IP address queries. In the PDU session journey, the critical UPF role is user-plane enforcement: SMF programs packet detection, forwarding, and QoS rules on the UPF (primarily via the N4 interface defined in TS 29.502). The 29.564 REST APIs complement N4 for event subscription and exposure.
defines: Nupf_EventExposure — subscribe to UPF events (usage, trends)
UPF as producer NF in service-based architecture
Event notification URIs provisioned via N4 or Subscribe
whyItMatters: SmPolicyDecision from PCF (29.512) becomes real traffic treatment only after SMF installs rules on the UPF. Without the UPF story, policy is abstract. N4 session establishment in 29.502 is the enforcement step; 29.564 documents the UPF's SBI surface for monitoring and exposure.
